name: Guyuk
notes: Guyuk the Seed-Gleaner, as she is in this age: a herbalist of the Aravali who keeps the Quiet Atelier and is seldom in it, and who does not remember being a nomad. Met only through her storyline (`storyline_guyuk`) -- no `found_at`, so she is never standing anywhere to be talked to until her arc brings her. The nomad girl of `character_guyuk` belongs to another age and reaches the player as traces only, by the epoch rule. Joins the walkers when her arc ends, by the owner's direction of 2 October 2026.
